setup-python.reason: Match Cortex8e7375bf and Spec616eb04 without downgrading consumer setup-python; legacy default unchanged.

strict-mcp-config.reason: Use the action-provided GitHub MCP configuration without autoloading consumer .mcp.json application launchers. Settings, skills and reviewer definitions are unchanged.

native-app-oidc.reason: Restore native Claude App attribution through OIDC exchange; retain same-repository/non-draft gate and restoring pinned action.

dependabot-secret-scope.reason: A Dependabot-triggered run receives Dependabot secrets only, so the review failed before any model call (cortex-viz run40819127887, PR212: Secret source Dependabot, empty CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, environment validation failed). Skip it as the legacy review job does; a person's push to the branch still runs the review.
sources: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-22-single-ci-design.md decision 5: no Dependabot secret is created

locked-cli.method: npm ci --prefix and GITHUB_PATH for private node_modules/.bin
locked-cli.reason: Replace four rendered global CLI installations with integrity-locked dependencies, without changing the CLI version or the legacy profile.

owner-model-selection.reason: Explicit owner selection of Opus5.5 for CI. The official model ID is verified; local rendering does not establish hosted action compatibility.

current-security-findings.reason: Require every finding announced by the current authenticated summary, but exclude historical thread IDs from its resolution verdict and receipt. Missing current identities and existing trust/protocol errors still fail closed.

summary-editor-authentication.reason: Read body and immutable last-editor attribution from the same GraphQL node. Require pristine null/null metadata or the original native Bot as editor, bound by stable Actor ID. Authenticate later original-Bot comments even when their summary marker was removed.

comment-boundary-module.reason: Preserve editor authentication behavior while satisfying the Cortex 300-line module cap. Extract cohesive comment API/authentication helpers, retain runtime compatibility callbacks, and preload the third trusted module before the reader.

resumption-contracts.reason: Deliver the existing observable decision/coordinator contracts plus direct full-proof reconciliation cases; production review helpers and supported event triggers are unchanged.

scheduled-reconciliation.reason: Review-thread resolution has no supported Actions event. A default-branch five-minute fallback prefilters paginated PR status rollups before existing authenticated resumption policy. Discovery is serialized per repository; API errors stop the scan. Per-PR protocol errors remain isolated. Full proof alone authorizes readiness repair or exact waiting gate reruns.

reconciliation-checks-read.reason: Declare job-local Checks read access for the discovery GraphQL CheckRun fields. Keep workflow defaults and other jobs unchanged. This is an evidence-backed permission declaration, not an observed public-runner failure or hosted acceptance.

structured-api-errors.reason: Preserve fixed not_found, forbidden, rate_limited or unknown transport category while str(error) remains api. Actual gh REST404 response includes status; --paginate --slurp wraps it in one array element. Never classify raw stderr or expose response bodies.

security-receipt-proof.reason: A Codex security review can complete with both verdict flags null while Codex posts an authenticated receipt 'No security issues were found' for the head (cortex-viz PR213 receipt6491350304, Cortex PR829 receipt6491478435); the gate stayed pending with no exit. A survey of 36 cdeust PRs on 2026-10-29 found 13 security receipts, all with that sentence, two automatic ones with the heading suffix '· _Automatically triggered_'. For a completed, current-head, null/null security review whose metadata names this repository, PR, head and completed status: a no-issues receipt from the native Bot with an authenticated editor and a head commit prefix is the verdict (success); no such receipt blocks as codex_security_verdict_missing; any other security receipt for the head blocks as codex_security_receipt_unrecognized (no observed receipt reports findings; findings arrive as explicit flags and keep the thread path). The gate names the cause and never relaunches a review; resume re-runs the failed review job once the proof succeeds.

receipt-event-resumption.reason: A security receipt can arrive after the Pipeline completed without a later summary edit; the authenticated comment-event filter only accepted the summary, so the receipt never resumed the gate (Codex finding4411383156). Accept a native-Bot comment that starts with the receipt marker as a resumption trigger. The event only identifies the PR; the comment is re-read through REST with the Bot author check and resume recomputes the full proof at the live head. The gate never requests a review.

proof-first-discovery.reason: Authenticate current-head GraphQL summaries before REST run/attempt discovery. Incomplete reviews and successful-review unresolved waits perform no REST work. Truncated gate contexts cannot veto an authorized readiness repair. Only known per-PR404 is isolated; quota/unknown transport and initial listing failures stop the scan.

bounded-completion-jobs.reason: Declared operational cap equals the existing five-minute schedule period for each non-model completion job; not an empirical service deadline. Observed Cortex run40626520816 identify9s and resume11s.

gate-name-collisions.reason: Use CheckRun-only grouped names as a superset hint. Duplicate native gates and partial contexts proceed to current full proof; StatusContext cannot shadow checks. No prerequisite veto is added without authenticated workflow identity. Unchanged full plan handles real failed prerequisites and superseded matrix placeholders.

merge-condition-diagnostics.reason: The live-eligibility step reported closed, draft, held and moved head with one sentence. Cortex run40583904933 failed on a deliberate 'do not merge' title and read as a moved head. Name the first failing condition and pass only on the value `eligible`: a failed `gh pr view`, an empty, blank or BOM-only read and any other jq result are refused as unreadable. The conditions that fail are those of the single-sentence form plus multiple jq results.

rerun-merge-job-identity.reason: Fold merge and merge pending review as one logical job across authenticated attempts; retain the newest original job payload and reject duplicate aliases in one attempt. Preserve unrelated historical failures.

owner-fix-permissions.reason: Owner-authored requests inherit pinned tag workspace edit approval instead of overriding acceptEdits with auto; explicitly allow test and git tools. Reject fork or default-branch PR targets before running the action. Preserve action App git authentication, owner-only comment context, native read-only review and merge gates.

private-repo-fetch.evidence: cdeust/ci-autonome job 123331564638: git fetch origin --depth=20 <head> failed with could not read Username on a private repository; cdeust/Cortex job 123333637093 (public, same template) fetched anonymously.
private-repo-fetch.reason: The pinned action fetches through origin before installing its App token. Keep persist-credentials false and give that fetch the job token as a local http extraheader, which the action unsets before Claude runs.

claude-review-verdict-marker.reason: The final native Claude review comment ends with exactly one line <!-- claude-review-verdict:v1 {"head":"<event head sha>","merge":true|false} -->, so the Cortex convergence planner reads the verdict for the reviewed head instead of reporting claude_verdict_unreadable. The head is the event's pull_request.head.sha, never model-chosen text.

reviewer-agreement-lifts-review-holds.rule: Owner rule 2026-10-29, verbatim: until the review of codex and claude (done autonomously) are there, it cannot merge, the hold should be removed after reviewers agree on merging.
reviewer-agreement-lifts-review-holds.evidence: GraphQL author of cdeust/claude-mods PR51 comment6494419619: login claude, __typename Bot, id BOT_kgDODIGtWg (REST claude[bot], comment6491944909).
reviewer-agreement-lifts-review-holds.reason: A head merges only when both native reviewers conclude for it: Codex code and security (flags or the native receipt) and the latest claude-review-verdict:v1 marker of the Claude App for that head with merge true. A missing reviewer keeps the gate pending under a named cause (codex_<kind>_verdict_missing, claude_verdict_missing); merge false blocks as claude_refused and a verdict edited by another account as claude_verdict_unreadable. hold and autopilot:hold mean reviews incomplete, as in the Cortex convergence planner: the merge job no longer fails on them, and the resolve job (main's definition, after workflow authorization) deletes them before the protected merge, re-reads the PR and refuses if any hold or a new head appears. do-not-merge and a do not merge title remain owner holds, never touched. Resumption no longer skips PRs with review holds, so a receipt or verdict that completes the reviews reruns the gate.

review-holds-not-read.rule: Owner rule 2026-11-03, verbatim: Retire les holds. With the review job no longer required (#231, owner rule 2026-10-29: a green Pipeline merges), the resolve job reads no review hold.
review-holds-not-read.supersedes: reviewer-agreement-lifts-review-holds, for the resolve job only: the review job still concludes on Codex and Claude and names its causes, but its verdict is not a merge condition.
review-holds-not-read.evidence: Claude review of cdeust/cortex-viz PR216, comment 6508578491, blocking finding 1: after #231 nothing in the merge path read review state, so _merge_open_pr deleted hold and autopilot:hold on green tests alone, before the PUT merge, overriding a human hold at the next green run.
review-holds-not-read.reason: hold and autopilot:hold are neither read, blocking nor deleted by the resolve job; the pinned source blocks on hold, the native job does not. do-not-merge and a do not merge title stay the owner's holds and refuse the merge before any API call. The urllib.parse quote import of the lift is removed with it.

codex-reaction-verdict.rule: Owner decision 2026-11-03 ("Oui pour le resolver"): port cdeust/Cortex PR847 into the native reader so a clean security review with null flags is proven by Codex's thumbs-up reaction when no receipt comment exists.
codex-reaction-verdict.evidence: From 2026-10-31 Codex posts no no-issues receipt and reacts +1 on the PR once both reviews finish with no findings: cortex-viz PR218 (06:13:28Z), PR219 and PR220 (07:38:47Z), PR216 (11:13:00Z); Cortex PR838, PR840, PR846, PR847. PRs reviewed before (cortex-viz PR207, PR212, PR217) carry neither. cortex-viz PR216 run of 2026-11-03: review job red with the single cause codex_security_verdict_missing while Claude and Codex code were clean.
codex-reaction-verdict.shipped_tests: scripts/tests/test_ci_codex_review_reaction.py: 14 contract tests, 100 % of the module's lines (the consumers' unit job fails under 90 % of lines: claude-mods PR61 run with the module and no test read 88.86 %).
codex-reaction-verdict.reason: security_receipt keeps precedence; its verdict_missing yields to resolve_no_findings: both Completed rows of the summary name this head, no finding text in the summary, the Codex Bot's +1 (reactions API reports it as type User, the login is read) is not earlier than the later row to the second, no eyes reaction remains, and no native finding thread is unresolved by the owner (runtime THREAD_QUERY and _thread_states). Any malformed reaction payload or stamp blocks as protocol. New authored asset scripts/ci_codex_review_reaction.py, embedded as REACTION_SOURCE after the comments module; the reader imports reaction_verdict.

dependabot-claude-not-applicable.evidence: GraphQL PullRequest.author of zetetic-team-subagents PR212: login dependabot, __typename Bot; headRefName dependabot/github_actions/github-actions-6fd5ed7583.
dependabot-claude-not-applicable.reason: Coordinator rule D5, 2026-10-29: the native Claude review skips Dependabot runs, which have no Actions secrets (PR224), so no claude-review-verdict:v1 marker can exist there. The comments query reads the PR author and branch from the same GraphQL node as the comments; on a PR authored by the dependabot Bot on a dependabot/* branch, an absent marker reads not_applicable_dependabot and counts as agreement, so both Codex kinds and the test jobs decide. An explicit Claude verdict still counts. Any other PR keeps claude_verdict_missing until its marker arrives.

codex-quota-wait.reason: Coordinator rule D6, 2026-10-29: from 13:00Z Codex marked reviews failed and posted a usage-limit notice ('has reached its Codex usage limits', 'You have reached your Codex usage limits for code reviews'). A failed kind whose latest Codex Bot comment is such a notice waits for quota: the gate stays pending as codex_quota_exhausted instead of blocking as review_failed, and resumes when Codex completes the review. A failed kind without that latest notice still blocks.

security-owner-resolution.reason: An explicit clean security verdict over findings (has_any_findings true, has_unresolved_findings false) goes through resolve_security like an unknown verdict: only the trusted owner's resolvedBy resolves a finding, never the summary flag. Without that proof the review is unresolved (owner_resolution_unproven).

receipt-head-binding.reason: A security receipt names its commit by a 10-hex prefix (40 bits); a branch writer can precompute two commits sharing it. The receipt proves the head only by its full SHA: 40 hex compared exactly, or a shorter prefix the repository's commits API resolves to one commit equal to the head. A 404, an ambiguous prefix or any API failure rejects the receipt. Authored asset: scripts/ci_codex_review_comments.py (digest only, no upstream inverse).

merge-is-the-test-aggregate.reason: Owner rule 2026-10-29: the merge job is the aggregate of the test jobs of the run. It waits for no review state and reads neither main nor the live pull request; the upstream live-eligibility, Codex reader and review-state steps are removed.

review-never-blocks.reason: Owner rule 2026-10-29: the review is not a required job. The review job keeps running and posting but cannot fail the Pipeline (continue-on-error), because the completion caller fires only on a successful run. The completion resolver requires the tests and their aggregate merge, never the review job, and the merge-pending-review state is gone.

tag-fetch-without-checkout.rule: Owner rule 2026-11-03: CodeQL findings are fixed, not dismissed. The tag job never checks out the tested commit.
tag-fetch-without-checkout.evidence: CodeQL actions/untrusted-checkout on Cortex PR839 (pipeline-post-merge.yml:971, high) and ai-architect-mcp-codebase PR471 (pipeline-post-merge.yml:972 high, pipeline.yml:1822 medium): checkout of untrusted code in a privileged workflow (workflow_run) with later potential execution, while the job holds the write-enabled RELEASE_TAG_SSH_KEY.
tag-fetch-without-checkout.reason: The publish script needs only the commit object and an authenticated origin. The step fetches the 40-hex tested_sha by SHA into a bare repository under runner.temp (git init --bare, fetch --depth=1), installs GitHub's SSH host keys from api.github.com/meta over TLS with StrictHostKeyChecking=yes, and the publish step runs there; nothing from the commit is checked out or executed.

merge-arms-auto-merge.rule: Owner rule 2026-11-03: a CI that blocks itself and cannot correct itself is not autonomous; the PR's own definition merges the PR.
merge-arms-auto-merge.evidence: spec PR168, Cortex PR839, codebase PR471 (2026-11-03): each PR fixes the merge gate, and main's completion resolver, running main's definition, refused them (source merge gate requires completed review); a human merge was the only exit.
merge-arms-auto-merge.reason: The merge job, once the test jobs of the run are green, runs gh pr merge --auto --squash --match-head-commit on its own PR. GitHub performs the squash when branch protection is satisfied (the merge check included), with the PR's definition as the only code in the path. Already armed, already merged and a disabled Allow auto-merge setting are not failures; the completion resolver stays as the fallback merger. A do-not-merge label or a 'do not merge' title, read live before arming, leaves the PR unarmed (owner holds stay owner holds; Codex finding on #238). Only PRs into main are armed (the resolve job's boundary), and a hold found on a later run revokes an earlier arming (gh pr merge --disable-auto), since GitHub keeps an armed request across a writer's push.

merge-requires-both-reviews.rule: Owner rule 2026-11-03 (23:29), verbatim: Le CI doit avoir une revue de codex et une revue de Claude, et il ne doit plus y avoir de bloquer remonte ni par l'un ni par l'autre pour que ca soit ok pour etre merge.
merge-requires-both-reviews.supersedes: review-never-blocks (owner rule 2026-10-29) for the merge condition: the review job is required again; the completion resolver on main still never reads it, the PR's own merge job does.
merge-requires-both-reviews.reason: The merge job needs the review job and reads its state output: success (Codex and Claude concluded for the head, no blocking finding) arms auto-merge; pending (a verdict missing) and blocked (a blocking finding or an unreadable verdict) fail the merge job with the causes named. The review job runs without continue-on-error, so a blocking finding fails the run. The Codex completion workflow re-runs the review job of the PR's run when a verdict lands, and re-run-a-job re-runs its dependents, the merge job included: the PR's own definition stays the only code in the merge path. The review step runs without --allow-pending (#205): a missing verdict exits 2 and fails the review job, the state the resumption plan (READINESS) re-runs. The merge job re-runs the reader live on the head (step 'Require complete Codex reviews', the name ci_codex_review_resume.MERGE pins), so a re-run of the merge job alone re-reads a finding resolved since (Codex finding on #240). In the legacy profile a Dependabot PR, whose review job is excluded by actor (#224), passes with the review skipped.

--no-schedule.effect: Remove only the schedule trigger and its explanatory comment; preserve issue_comment, workflow_run, workflow_dispatch and all jobs. Default native assets remain byte-identical.
